name.value: The Flying Apron Café and Bakery

description.value: The Flying Apron is a scratch bakery and café in Comox, BC, where a Red Seal Pastry Chef—three-time Skills Canada Provincial medallist—leads a team that begins baking before sunrise daily. The menu rotates seasonally and spans fresh breads, laminated pastries, artisan cakes, and cookies, all made in-house from locally sourced ingredients. Dedicated gluten-free and vegan options are consistently available, making it a welcoming stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions.

address.value: 268 Anderton Road, Comox, British Columbia V9M 3M6, Canada
